title.narrative: Private sector and quality promotion programme for Mozambique - COMPETIR com Qualidade

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to enhance and strengthen the level of development and the competitiveness of private sector companies through the following: - The dialogue and policy on the national quality system will be improved. This will be achieved through policy dialogue on quality and the related industrial policy as well as through the creation of awareness and training on better Mozambican Technical Regulations in partnership with Consumer Association and private sector. - The Mozambican conformity assessment system is nationally, regionally and internationally recognised. The Mozambican conformity assessment system is recognised with the accreditation of INNOQ and of some laboratories in selected priority areas in line with international standards. - INNOQ becomes increasingly sustainable and its institutional and operational structure is reformed. The sustainability of INNOQ is increased through institutional and operational reforms such as introduction of cost accounting and marketing. Its capacity as a bu siness to business (B2B) provider of services such as calibration, certification, standards and training is strengthened, increasing its financial sustainability. - Increased application of voluntary consensual standards.
